spans.s:
cintā-para, a. having sad thought as
one's chief thing, sunk in sad thought.
[1302b.]

cintāviṣa-ghna, a. destroying the poison
of sorrow.

cintitopasthita, a. which approached
as soon as thought of. [lit. ‘thought of
and (immediately) at hand,’ cintita +
upasthita, 1257.]

cintya, grdv. to be thought of, comprehensible.
 [√cint.]
